newsitem.title: JAPAN: Strong tremor rocks Tokyo - residents.
newsitem.headline: Strong tremor rocks Tokyo - residents.

text.p: A strong tremor shook homes and office buildings in Tokyo on Wednesday, but there were no immediate indications of any damage or casualties, residents said.
The earthquake, centered in northwestern Chiba prefecture next to the Japanese capital of Tokyo, measured five on the open-ended Richter scale, the Meteorological Agency said.
The quake registered three on the Japanese scale of seven in Tokyo and its vicinities, the agency said.
Residents said it was the strongest tremor they have felt in some time in the capital.
The Meteorological Agency said there was no possibility of the tremor triggering tidal waves in the area, and there were no immediate reports of disruption to public transport.
